title: 第1359章 大战落幕大魏皇朝援军全军覆灭第1358章 羽东侯装逼跑路失败
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
统帅羽东侯薛霸很清楚，自己彻底完了。
当那枚闪烁着幽微灵光、足以让他瞬间遁出千万里的“小挪移符”从掌心脱离时，
轻飘飘落入对面那个黑袍人手中时，
他心中最后一丝希冀也随之彻底熄灭。
他知道，
自己这一次是彻底栽在了大萧皇朝那令人闻风丧胆、如影随形的情报机构“密谍司”手里。
失去了这张足以逆转生死的底牌，
曾经权倾朝野、一言九鼎的羽东侯薛霸，
此刻不过是一只被拔了牙、待宰的羔羊而已。
凛冽的寒风呼啸而过，
吹得薛霸身上那件象征尊贵的锦袍猎猎作响，
也吹凉了他额头上细密的冷汗。
作为大魏皇朝皇帝魏渊的心腹爱将，
羽东侯薛霸的脑袋向来转得比常人快，心思更是活络。
恐惧只在他眼中停留了一瞬，
随即被一种近乎谄媚的决绝所取代。
他猛地挥动仅剩的一只手，
声音因急切而显得有些尖锐，
“大人！大人且慢！我愿投降！我不光投降，我还愿做带路党，
助大萧皇朝出征军攻城略地！

尤其是淮莱城，我有把握不费大萧一兵一卒，为您双手奉上！
那淮莱的城防图就在我脑子里，只需给我一条生路！”
话音刚落，空气仿佛凝固了一瞬间。
身穿黑袍的密谍司副司主萧无影，
修长的手指轻轻抚摸着那枚小挪移符，嘴角勾起一抹玩味的弧度，眼神中满是轻蔑好嘲讽，
“哟，这就是堂堂大魏皇朝的统帅羽东侯？”
副司主萧无影的声音不大，却清晰地钻入在场每个人的耳中，
“这变脸的速度，倒是比刚才那瞬移符还要快上几分。本司主算是开了眼了。”
他轻叹一声，故作惋惜地摇了摇头道，
“可惜啊，本司主耳朵不好使，刚才明明听得真真切切，
薛大将军可是豪言壮语：‘生是大魏皇朝的将，死是大魏皇朝的鬼’。
怎么，这鬼还没做成，就想变回人了？
这大魏皇朝的忠烈之语，原来就值一座淮莱城吗？”
此言一出，
周围一众大萧皇朝中路军的将领们顿时哄堂大笑，笑声中充满了鄙夷和嘲讽。
content_en:
The commander-in-chief, Yu Donghou Xue Ba, knew very well that he was completely doomed.
When the "little teleportation talisman" that shimmered with faint spiritual light and was enough to allow him to escape thousands of miles in an instant fell out of his palm,
When it fell lightly into the hands of the man in black robe opposite,
The last glimmer of hope in his heart was completely extinguished.
He knows,
This time, I completely fell into the hands of the Great Xiao Dynasty's feared and ever-present intelligence agency, the Secret Intelligence Department.
Losing this trump card that could reverse life and death,
Xue Ba, the Marquis of Yudong, who once had all the power in the government and everyone,
At this moment, he is just a lamb with its teeth pulled out, waiting to be slaughtered.
The biting cold wind howled by,
It made the brocade robe on Xue Ba's body, symbolizing nobility, rustle.
It also cooled the fine cold sweat on his forehead.
As a confidant of Emperor Wei Yuan of the Wei Dynasty,
Yudong Hou Xue Ba's head has always turned faster than ordinary people, and his mind is even more active.
The fear only stayed in his eyes for a moment,
It was immediately replaced by an almost flattering determination.
He waved his remaining hand violently,
The voice was a bit sharp due to urgency,
"My lord! Sir, please wait! I am willing to surrender! Not only do I surrender, I also want to lead the way.
Help the Great Xiao Dynasty's expeditionary army to conquer cities and territories!
Especially for Huai Lai City, I am confident that I can offer it to you with both hands without using any of Da Xiao's troops!
The city defense map of Huai Lai is in my mind. All I need is to give me a way out! "
As soon as he finished speaking, the air seemed to freeze for a moment.
Xiao Wuying, the deputy chief of the Secret Intelligence Department, wearing a black robe,
His slender fingers gently stroked the small moving talisman, and the corners of his mouth curved in a playful way, his eyes full of contempt and ridicule.
"Hey, is this the majestic commander-in-chief of the Wei Dynasty, Yu Donghou?"
Deputy Chief Xiao Wuying’s voice was not loud, but it reached the ears of everyone present clearly.
"The speed of this change of face is actually a bit faster than the teleportation talisman just now. My boss has opened his eyes."
He sighed softly, shook his head pretending to be regretful and said,
"It's a pity that my boss' ears are not good. I heard it very clearly just now.
General Xue made a bold statement: "You are a general of the Wei Dynasty in life, and you are a ghost of the Wei Dynasty in death."
Why, this ghost wants to turn back into a human before it's done?
Are these words of loyalty from the Wei Dynasty worth a Huai Lai city? "
As soon as this statement came out,
The surrounding generals of the Central Route Army of the Great Xiao Dynasty suddenly burst into laughter, and the laughter was full of contempt and ridicule.
